parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
The speed $v$ of a sound wave through a gas of pressure $P$ and density $\rho$ is given by the equation $$v = \sqrt{\frac{kP}{\rho}}$$ where $k$ is a constant that has no units.

An experiment is performed to determine the value of $k$. The data from the experiment are shown in Fig. 1.1.

| {{header}} quantity | {{header}} value | {{header}} uncertainty |
|---|---|---|
| $v$ | $3.3 \times 10^{2}\text{ m s}^{-1}$ | $\pm 3\%$ |
| $P$ | $9.9 \times 10^{4}\text{ Pa}$ | $\pm 2\%$ |
| $\rho$ | $1.29\text{ kg m}^{-3}$ | $\pm 4\%$ |

Fig. 1.1

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Use data from Fig. 1.1 to calculate $k$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Use your answer in (b)(i) and data from Fig. 1.1 to determine the value of $k$, with its absolute uncertainty, to an appropriate number of significant figures.
